content_quality.description: Content patterns that reduce value and engagement

generic_summary.name: generic_summary
examples: Made some changes to the code
generic_summary.why_avoid: Zero value for future reference. Doesn't capture what was actually done.
generic_summary.fix: Include specific files, line numbers, tools used, and concrete outcomes

instant_success.name: instant_success
instant_success.why_avoid: Unrealistic. Every real session involves struggle, dead ends, and iteration.
instant_success.fix: Document the failures, wrong turns, and evolution of understanding

no_rationale.name: no_rationale
no_rationale.why_avoid: Future you (and others) need to know WHY, not just WHAT.
no_rationale.fix: Always include the reasoning behind decisions and alternatives considered

missing_failures.name: missing_failures
missing_failures.why_avoid: Failures are more educational than successes. Hiding them loses value.
missing_failures.fix: Document what didn't work and why—it's often more valuable than the solution

vague_outcomes.name: vague_outcomes
vague_outcomes.why_avoid: Unmeasurable claims. Without metrics, impossible to verify impact.
vague_outcomes.fix: Include specific metrics: '20% faster', '3 files removed', '50 lines reduced'

social_media.description: Social media post patterns that perform poorly

weak_hook.name: weak_hook
weak_hook.why_avoid: Generic openings that don't grab attention. Low engagement.
weak_hook.fix: Start with controversy, surprise, numbers, or strong statements

no_value.name: no_value
no_value.why_avoid: So what? Readers need to know what's in it for them.
no_value.fix: Always answer: 'What will the reader learn or gain?'

code_only.name: code_only
code_only.why_avoid: Code without context is just noise. Needs story and explanation.
code_only.fix: Set up the problem first, then show code as the solution

cta_missing.name: cta_missing
cta_missing.why_avoid: Missed opportunity for comments, shares, follows.
cta_missing.fix: Always end with question, request for thoughts, or call-to-action

hashtag_spam.name: hashtag_spam
hashtag_spam.why_avoid: Looks spammy. LinkedIn shows 3 hashtags, Twitter allows 2.
hashtag_spam.fix: Use 2-3 highly relevant, targeted hashtags per platform

wall_of_text.name: wall_of_text
wall_of_text.why_avoid: Hard to read on mobile. Low completion rate.
wall_of_text.fix: Use line breaks, bullets, emojis as visual anchors, short paragraphs

humble_brag.name: humble_brag
examples: So tired from all these job offers
Can't believe my project went viral again
humble_brag.why_avoid: People see through it. Creates resentment, not engagement.
humble_brag.fix: Share struggles, not just successes. Be authentic about the journey

script_theater.description: Script patterns that don't translate to engaging video

monologue.name: monologue
examples: Assistant explains everything without user interaction
monologue.why_avoid: Boring. Drama needs conflict and dialogue.
monologue.fix: Include user questions, objections, and feedback. Make it a conversation.

no_emotion.name: no_emotion
no_emotion.why_avoid: Robotic. Viewers connect with human emotions.
no_emotion.fix: Show the struggle: 'Wait, that didn't work...', 'Oh! I see it now!'

teleport_solution.name: teleport_solution
teleport_solution.why_avoid: Unrealistic. Misses the thinking process viewers want to see.
teleport_solution.fix: Show the evolution: tried X, failed, tried Y, failed, realized Z

no_dead_ends.name: no_dead_ends
no_dead_ends.why_avoid: Suspicious. Every real session has failures.
no_dead_ends.fix: Include at least 2-3 dead ends or wrong turns before breakthrough

missing_context.name: missing_context
missing_context.why_avoid: Viewers can't follow without seeing what's being worked on.
missing_context.fix: Always include: 📄 file.ext:line - action being taken

style_profiles.description: Misusing style profiles or wrong profile selection

wrong_profile.name: wrong_profile
wrong_profile.why_avoid: Content feels off. Mismatch between tone and content.
wrong_profile.fix: Match profile to session: technical (code-heavy), storytelling (struggles), educational (teaching), opinion (debates)

profile_hopping.name: profile_hopping
profile_hopping.fix: Choose ONE profile and apply it consistently throughout

ignoring_platform.name: ignoring_platform
examples: Blog posts that are too short
ignoring_platform.why_avoid: Platform norms exist for reasons. Breaking them hurts performance.
ignoring_platform.fix: Respect platform constraints: LinkedIn (3000 chars, formatted), Twitter (280 chars, thread)

generation_process.description: Anti-patterns in the content generation workflow

skipping_context.name: skipping_context
skipping_context.why_avoid: Output will be generic, inaccurate, or hallucinated.
skipping_context.fix: Always collect full session context: messages, tools, files, outcomes

ignoring_quality_gates.name: ignoring_quality_gates
ignoring_quality_gates.fix: Validate all sections before writing: all present, all filled, all specific

hallucinating_details.name: hallucinating_details
hallucinating_details.why_avoid: Breaks trust. Future reference will be wrong.
hallucinating_details.fix: Only use facts from actual session. If unsure, don't include.

over_generating.name: over_generating
over_generating.why_avoid: Wastes tokens. Creates noise. User didn't ask for it.
over_generating.fix: Generate only what was requested: conversation (always), script (if video), posts (if social)

under_generating.name: under_generating
under_generating.why_avoid: Output is incomplete. Not ready to use.
under_generating.fix: Complete all sections. Fill all placeholders. Pass all quality gates.

generating_too_soon.name: generating_too_soon
generating_too_soon.why_avoid: Low-value content wastes space and tokens.
generating_too_soon.fix: Only generate for substantial sessions (15+ minutes, multiple tools, real work)

generating_without_permission.name: generating_without_permission
generating_without_permission.fix: Hook is automatic, but make clear what's being generated. Allow manual opt-out.

ignoring_sensitivity.name: ignoring_sensitivity
ignoring_sensitivity.why_avoid: Security risk. May violate NDAs or company policy.
ignoring_sensitivity.fix: Check for secrets, proprietary mentions before generating public content

inconsistent_structure.name: inconsistent_structure
inconsistent_structure.why_avoid: Hard to parse. Confusing for future reference.
inconsistent_structure.fix: Use consistent structure: metadata → objective → approach → decisions → outcome → learnings

missing_metadata.name: missing_metadata
missing_metadata.why_avoid: Can't organize or find sessions later.
missing_metadata.fix: Always include: date, duration, files modified, tools used, outcome
